questions.question: How long does the import job take for a large archive?

asked_sources.quote: How long does the import job take

answers.text: A ten gigabyte archive usually takes about 40 minutes on one worker.

sources.quote: it usually finishes in about 40 minutes on one worker

questions.combined_answer: A ten gigabyte archive usually finishes in **about 40 minutes** on one worker.

questions.question: Does the import resume after a crash?

answers.text: Yes; every stage writes a checkpoint.

questions.combined_answer: Yes. Every stage writes a checkpoint, so it resumes where it stopped.
